no_additional_acquisition.reason: OIF-specific channel, reach, lane and topology definitions are already evidence-grounded; cross-standard generalization is a separate future research question.

deferred.reason: Route comparison depends on measurement methods, denominators and scenario definitions that are not yet established.

research_objectives.objective: Establish bounded understanding of S-parameter and insertion-loss measurement, fixture removal, de-embedding, test coupons, uncertainty and reference-plane conventions.
Establish when Dk and Df declarations are comparable across method, frequency, direction, environment, sample construction and supplier status.
Verify the existing experiment's publication provenance and seek independent matched-condition evidence on copper profile and roughness variables.
Assess scoped rate, frequency, distance and channel-metric relationships only after measurement denominators are established.

prohibited_inferences: Measurement-method understanding does not establish PCB manufacturing bottlenecks.
Material-parameter comparability does not rank materials or suppliers.
A bounded copper-roughness experiment does not establish an industry-wide rule.
Rate-distance measurement relationships do not establish material upgrades, capacity constraints or value migration.
Industry evidence does not establish company exposure or stock investment value.
